question: Which of the following does NOT belong to class Insects?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scorpion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scorpion **does NOT belong to class Insects.
 
• **Scorpions **are **arachnids characterized **by **their eight legs** and **nocturnal carnivorous habits**.
 
• They **inhabit diverse environments, **ranging from deserts and plains to savannas, forests, rainforests, and even caves.
 
• One unique feature of scorpions among arachnids is their method of reproduction. Unlike most other arachnids, which lay eggs, scorpions give birth to live young.
 
• This reproductive strategy is known as ovoviviparity, where the eggs develop and hatch inside the female's body, and the young are then born live.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Insects,** derived from the Latin term "insectum," are hexapod invertebrates of the** class Insecta**.
 
• They have a chitinous exoskeleton, a three-part body (head, thorax, and abdomen), three pairs of jointed legs, compound eyes, and a pair of antennae.
 
• They are the largest group within the arthropod phylum and the most diverse group of animals, with more than a million described species, representing more than half of all animal species.
 
• Most insects reproduce by laying eggs. The insect nervous system consists of a brain and a ventral nerve cord.
